about: GENERATED FILE: do not edit the notes here (they come from assets/languages/context.json). To translate: change "code" and "name" above, then type each translation into the "translation" field and leave everything else as it is. "context" says what a text is for and "used_in" which source file shows it; both are ignored when the file loads, so there is nothing to remove. Texts left empty stay in English. Keep {placeholders} like {count} unchanged. See docs/localization.md.
name: Template: change code and name, then fill in the translations

(excluded).context: Added after a document's title in the binder when it is left out of the compile. Keep the two leading spaces.

(no suggestions).context: Shown in the spelling menu when a misspelled word has no suggested corrections.

+ Add element.context: Button below a script that adds a new line (scene heading, action, dialogue…) to the document.

+ New card.context: Corkboard button that adds a new card (a new document).

+ New item.context: Database button that adds a new character, place or other item.

+ New note.context: Research page button that adds a new research note.

+ block.context: Small button below a script that adds a new line (a script 'block').

+{count} added.context: Version comparison summary: number of words added since the saved version. Keep {count}.

/path/to/image.png.context: Example file path shown as faint hint text in the Insert image box. Keep it as a path.

1 day.context: Singular in the writing-streak line ('Current run: 1 day').

608 / 1200 today.context: Example of the daily goal shown in the top bar: words written today out of the goal. Only the word 'today' is text.

API · MCP · CLI.context: List of technical names (programming interfaces). Keep unchanged.

About Portmanteau.context: Title of the About window (Help menu).

Act.context: Script element or document kind: a major division of a play (as in 'Act II').

Action.context: Script element: a line of description of what happens on screen (as in a screenplay), not a button.

Add a synopsis….context: Hint in an empty synopsis box: a one or two sentence summary of a document.

Add files….context: Button on the Research page that opens a file dialog to attach files to a note.

Add this tag.context: Button that adds the tag just typed to a database item.

Add to.context: Import review: the label for choosing where in the binder the imported documents go (a folder). A short label before a drop-down.

Add to dictionary.context: Spelling menu item: remember this word so it is not flagged again.

Added.context: Statistics table column: words added while writing (as a count).

Address.context: Link dialog field: the web address (URL) a link points to.

All changes saved.context: Status bar message: nothing is waiting to be saved.

Also include.context: Compile page heading: extra material (title page, contents, …) to add besides the manuscript.

Alt text.context: Short for alternative text: the description of a picture for screen readers.

Appearance.context: Settings tab for colours and themes.

Appearances.context: Database item section: the documents where this character or place appears.

Apply link.context: Button in the link dialog that applies the link to the selected text.

As.context: Import review: label before a drop-down choosing what an imported file becomes (for example prose or a screenplay).

Author's notes.context: Heading for a short list of notes the writer keeps for themselves about the work.

Automation.context: Page heading for the Command desk (the page where JSON commands are run).

Back Matter.context: Name of the binder folder holding pages after the story (acknowledgements, author biography).

Badges.context: Statistics window section listing achievements earned for writing habits.

Binder.context: The left-hand tree listing every document of the project (like a book's table of contents). A Scrivener-style term.

Bring it back.context: Button that restores something that was set aside or removed.

Browse….context: Button that opens a file dialog to pick a file or folder.

Call.context: Command desk: heading for the box where the writer types the command to run (not a phone call).

Cancel.context: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

Caption (standalone image).context: Label of the caption field for a picture that sits on its own line.

Card size.context: Corkboard: slider label for how big the cards are.

Changes restored.context: Notice after earlier changes were brought back.

Chapter.context: A binder document kind: a chapter of a book (also an episode or act in scripts).

Chapter One.context: Title given to the first chapter of a new project.

Chapter Two.context: Title given to the second chapter of a new project.

Character.context: Two uses: a character (person) in the story database, and the script element that holds a speaker's name above their dialogue.

Character created.context: Notice after a new database character is made.

Charts.context: Statistics tab: charts of time and words.

Check for Updates….context: Help menu item: look for a newer version of the program.

Check now.context: Button in Settings that checks for updates immediately.

Checking for updates….context: Shown while the update check runs.

Checkpoint saved.context: Notice after a whole-project checkpoint is saved.

Choose another….context: Button to pick a different file or folder than the current one.

Choose….context: Button that opens a chooser (file dialog).

Clear.context: Button on the Command desk that empties the response box.

Clipboard is empty.context: Notice when the writer tries to paste and nothing was copied.

Close (Esc).context: Tooltip of a close button; Esc is the Escape key.

Collections.context: Binder heading above shortcuts to Corkboard and Research notes.

Colour.context: Label for choosing a colour (British spelling in English).

Colours.context: Appearance tab: heading for the list of theme colours.

Command desk.context: Name of the page for running JSON commands, used by scripts and AI agents. A power-user feature.

Command failed.context: Notice when a command run from the Command desk returned an error.

Command ran.context: Notice when a command run from the Command desk succeeded.

Commands.context: Command desk: list heading for the available commands.

Compare.context: Button that shows the differences between a saved version and the current text.

Compile.context: Name of the page, and the verb: turn the project into a finished file such as a PDF or EPUB. Scrivener-style term.

Compile & export….context: File menu item that opens the Compile page.

Compile as.context: Label before a drop-down choosing the kind of manuscript (prose, screenplay…).

Compile failed.context: Notice when making the output file failed.

Contents.context: Compile section and a table-of-contents option: which documents go in, and the printed contents list.

Continue.context: Button that accepts and moves on.

Continuous.context: Editor view mode: one long scrolling page, as opposed to Paged.

Corkboard.context: Page showing documents as index cards on a board.

Could not save.context: Title of an error notice when saving failed.

Cover.context: Name of the cover section in the Compile preview's section list, and the cover picture setting.

Cover picture.context: Label for choosing the picture used as cover.

Create.context: Button that creates what was just filled in (a project, a note…).

Create a character.context: Button in the empty database to add the first character.

Create project.context: Button in the New project window.

Created {date}.context: Document information: when it was created. Keep {date}.

Custom.context: Choice meaning 'set by the writer' rather than automatic.

Database.context: Page and binder name for the story database: characters, places, events, props.

Days.context: Statistics chart period: one bar per day.

Defaults.context: Settings heading for the starting values used by new projects.

Defaults applied.context: Notice after global defaults were copied into the current project.

Defaults reset.context: Notice after defaults were returned to the program's own.

Delete.context: Button or menu item that removes something.

Delete note.context: Button that removes a research note.

Deleted.context: Statistics table column: words deleted while writing.

Describe the image.context: Hint in the picture description (alt text) box.

Detailed statistics….context: Button opening the full writing statistics window.

Development.context: A label (a coloured tag) for a section in the middle of the story: the development after the opening.

Dialogue.context: Script element: the words a character speaks.

Discard it.context: Button that throws away unsaved or recovered work.

Display.context: Settings tab for how the program looks (text size, zoom…).

Display uppercase.context: Style option: show the text in capitals without changing the typed text.

Document.context: A single binder entry (chapter, scene, note). Inspector tab name too.

Document snapshots.context: Heading for saved copies of one document.

Document versions.context: Heading for earlier versions of the open document.

Don't save.context: Button in the quit question: leave without saving.

Download.context: Button that downloads something (an update, or the file in the web version).

Draft.context: Two uses: a document status (a first rough version) and the name of the main binder folder that holds the manuscript. The binder folder name is looked up by the program in English, so only the display is translated.

Drag to reorder.context: Tooltip on a handle: drag it to change the order.

Edit.context: Menu name (Edit menu) and a button to change something.

Edit link….context: Menu item that opens the link dialog for an existing link.

Edited.context: Statistics column: words edited (changed), and a short word meaning the item was changed.

Edited {date}.context: Document information: when last changed. Keep {date}.

Editor zoom.context: Setting for how large the writing text is on the page.

Enter →.context: Hint beside an element: what it turns into when Enter is pressed (the next script element).

Event.context: Story database item kind: something that happens (a battle, a wedding).

Exclude from compile.context: Binder menu item: leave this document out of the compiled output.

Export template….context: Button that saves an empty translation file to fill in. Don't translate 'template' as anything but a blank form.

Export….context: Button that writes something to a file.

Extension.context: Script element: the small note after a character's name, such as (V.O.) or (O.S.).

File attached.context: Notice after a file was added to a research note.

Fill example.context: Command desk button that fills the Call box with an example command.

Final.context: A document status: finished, nothing more to change.

Find.context: Label and hint for the search box in the editor (find text).

Finish.context: Small heading above the Compile page title: the last stage of writing a book (a section label, not an instruction).

Fit width.context: Zoom option: scale so the page fills the width.

Focus.context: Button that starts distraction-free writing mode.

Focus mode (F11).context: Tooltip of the Focus button. F11 is a key.

Folder.context: A binder folder that holds other documents.

Folder name.context: Label of the box where a folder's name is typed.

Format.context: Inspector heading: the document's format (prose, screenplay…).

Front Matter.context: Name of the binder folder holding pages before the story (title page, dedication).

General.context: Script element: ordinary text with no special role.

Global.context: Appearance tab: heading above sliders that change every colour at once (hue, saturation, lightness).

Global font.context: Setting: the one typeface used by styles that don't choose their own.

Habits.context: Statistics window section about when and how often the writer writes.

Header from top.context: Compile layout: distance from the top edge of the page to the page header, in points.

Headers & footers.context: Compile layout heading for text printed at the top and bottom of each page.

Heading.context: A paragraph style for chapter or section titles.

Help and guides.context: Title of the notice shown when the help (wiki) address is opened.

Help and guides….context: Help menu item that opens the online help.

Hovered.context: Appearance preview: label of a button shown in its mouse-over state.

How it reads.context: Statistics window section about readability (sentence lengths and so on).

Image file.context: Label of the file picker in Insert image.

Image inserted.context: Notice after a picture was placed in the text.

Image….context: Insert menu item: put a picture in the text.

Import….context: Button/menu item that brings a file in from another program.

In progress.context: A document status: being worked on.

Include in compile.context: Checkbox: whether this document is part of the compiled output.

Insert field….context: Menu item for inserting an automatic value (page number, title) into a header or footer.

Intercut.context: Script element: a marker that the scene cuts back and forth between two places.

Interface language.context: Setting: the language of menus and buttons.

Interface text size.context: Setting: the size of menu and button text.

Justify.context: Text alignment choice: justified (straight left and right edges).

Keep.context: Button that keeps something (for example keeps an attached file or a recovered version).

Keep it.context: Button that keeps what was found (the opposite of Discard it).

Kind.context: Label for the type of an item (character, place, event…); also a sort order.

Label.context: Inspector field: a coloured tag attached to a document (Opening, Development…). Not a form label.

Label this moment.context: Hint for the name box when saving a checkpoint.

Language added.context: Notice after a language file was imported.

Large.context: Interface text size choice: bigger than standard.

Larger.context: Interface text size choice: the biggest.

Later.context: Button that postpones, as in the update notice.

Left.context: Text or picture alignment choice: left.

Link.context: A web link or link to another note, and the toolbar button for it.

Linked from.context: Database item section: other items that link to this one.

Live preview.context: Heading of the preview that updates as settings change.

Look in.context: Search page: label before choices of where to search (manuscript, research…).

Lyric.context: Script element: a line of a song.

Manuscript.context: Search group: the documents of the book itself (not research or the database).

Manuscript imported.context: Notice after a file was imported.

Mentioned in.context: Research note section: the documents that mention it.

Mixed media.context: Project kind: a project mixing prose and scripts.

Most-used words.context: Statistics section listing words used most often.

Move document down.context: Tooltip: move this document later in the binder.

Move document up.context: Tooltip: move this document earlier in the binder.

Move down.context: Menu item: move later in a list.

Move selected down.context: Tooltip: move the chosen item later.

Move selected up.context: Tooltip: move the chosen item earlier.

Move up.context: Menu item: move earlier in a list.

Name this version….context: Hint for naming a saved version.

New chapter.context: Button or menu item creating a chapter.

New character.context: Button or title for adding a database character.

New document.context: Binder context-menu item: create a new document inside the selected folder.

New folder.context: Binder menu item: create a folder.

New research note.context: Title of a freshly added research note.

New style.context: Default name of a new paragraph style.

Next match (Enter).context: Tooltip on the Find bar's next button.

Next ›.context: Pager button: next page of results.

No checkpoints yet..context: Empty-state message in the checkpoint list.

No research yet.context: Empty-state heading on the Research page.

No results..context: Search page empty state (with full stop).

No word here.context: Spelling menu message: the caret is not on a word.

None.context: Choice meaning nothing selected (no label, no cover).

Not opened.context: Title of a notice when a link could not be opened.

Note.context: Document format for plain notes, and the kind of a research note.

Notes.context: Notes attached to a document (never printed). Inspector tab name.

Nothing open.context: Message when no document is open.

Nothing to page.context: Message in Paged view when there is nothing to lay out in pages.

Open in Research.context: Button that opens a research note on the Research page.

Open link.context: Menu item that follows a link.

Open project zip….context: File menu item (web version): open a project saved as a zip file.

Open project….context: File menu item: open a project folder.

Open recent.context: File menu submenu listing recently opened projects.

Open the file.context: Button that opens an exported file.

Open this document.context: Tooltip: go to this document in the editor.

Open this item.context: Tooltip: go to this database item.

Open writing statistics.context: Tooltip of the daily-goal meter in the top bar.

Opening.context: A label (a coloured tag) for the beginning section of a story.

Outline.context: Page showing the manuscript as a table; also a document status (a plan, not yet written).

Output.context: Compile heading: the format to produce.

Page & type.context: Compile layout heading: paper size and text font.

Page margins.context: Compile layout heading: space around the text.

Paged.context: Editor view mode: shows the text as real printed pages. Opposite of Continuous.

Paper.context: Label before the paper size drop-down (US Letter, A4…).

Parenthetical.context: Script element: a short direction in brackets under a character's name, e.g. (whispering).

Paste clipping.context: Button that makes a research note from copied text.

Picture not changed.context: Notice when a picture edit had no effect.

Place.context: Story database item kind: a location.

Portmanteau.context: The program's name. Normally keep unchanged.

Position.context: Picture setting: where it sits (left, centre, right).

Previous match (Shift+Enter).context: Tooltip on the Find bar's previous button.

Project.context: The whole book/script being written; also the page for its title and author.

Project checkpoints.context: Heading for the list of whole-project checkpoints.

Project compass.context: Heading of a block summarising the project's idea (logline). Awkward name, may be renamed.

Project exported.context: Notice after exporting the project as a zip.

Prop.context: Story database item kind: an object that matters in the story.

Prose.context: Document format: ordinary book text, as opposed to a script.

Protagonist, ally, antagonist….context: Hint text in the Role box for a character.

Quit.context: Menu item that closes the program.

Reading.context: Statistics column: time spent reading, as opposed to typing.

Redo ⇧⌘Z.context: Edit menu item with its keyboard shortcut. Keep the shortcut and spaces.

Release page.context: Link to the page of a new version.

Remove.context: Button that takes something out of a list.

Remove link.context: Menu item that turns a link back into plain text.

Remove picture.context: Menu item that deletes a picture from the text.

Replace.context: Hint of the replacement box, and button that replaces the current match.

Research.context: Page, binder section and note type for gathered background material.

Research mentioned here.context: Section listing research notes named in this document.

Research note.context: One entry on the Research page.

Reset defaults.context: Button returning defaults to the program's own.

Reset sliders.context: Appearance button that returns the global colour sliders to zero.

Response.context: Command desk: heading for the box showing the result of a command.

Restart at 1.context: Option: page numbering begins again at 1.

Restore.context: Button that brings back an earlier saved version of a document or project.

Restore this version.context: Button that brings back an earlier saved version.

Reveal.context: A label (a coloured tag) for the part of a story where a secret is revealed.

Revised.context: A document status: rewritten after a first draft.

Right.context: Text or picture alignment choice: right.

Role.context: Database field: a character's role in the story.

Run command ▸.context: Button on the Command desk. Keep the spacing and arrow.

Save a checkpoint.context: Heading/button for saving a whole-project checkpoint.

Save a version.context: Heading/button for saving a snapshot of one document.

Save checkpoint.context: File menu item: save a named copy of the whole project that can be restored later.

Save defaults.context: Button saving the current settings as the defaults for new projects.

Scene.context: A binder document kind: a scene; also the script element heading of a scene.

Script.context: Format and label for a screenplay-style document.

Script pages.context: Compile option group for script page layout.

Search.context: Page name for searching the whole project.

Search project… (Ctrl+Shift+F).context: Hint of the top-bar search box. Keep the shortcut.

Search whole project.context: Button that opens the Search page with the typed text.

Section.context: Import review column naming a part of the imported file.

Sentence lengths.context: Statistics heading: how long the sentences are.

Sentences.context: Statistics row: the number of sentences.

Shot.context: Script element: a camera shot instruction.

Skip this version.context: Update notice button: do not offer this version again.

Sourcebook.context: Research page section listing where research came from.

Sources.context: Research page heading: sources of notes.

Space around.context: Picture setting: blank space around a picture.

Spell-checking in editors.context: Checkbox: underline misspelled words while typing.

Spelling language.context: Setting: which dictionary to check spelling with.

Spelling · {count}.context: Toolbar button showing the number of misspellings. Keep {count}.

Stage.context: Format and label for stage plays.

Standard.context: Interface text size choice: normal size.

Status.context: Inspector field: how finished a document is (To do, Draft, Final).

Story database.context: Full name of the Database page.

Structure.context: Small heading above the Corkboard and Outline page titles.

Subheading.context: Paragraph style for a heading below a chapter title.

Synopsis.context: A one or two sentence summary of a document (shown on corkboard cards).

Take snapshot.context: Edit menu item: save a copy of the open document to compare or restore later.

Template not saved.context: Notice: the translation template could not be written.

Text.context: Document kind or search part: ordinary text.

The work.context: Small heading above the Project page title (the work being written).

Theme added.context: Notice after a theme file was imported.

Time.context: Statistics switch: show time (minutes) rather than words. Also the History table column.

Title.context: A document's title; also a sort order.

Transition.context: Script element: an edit instruction at the end of a scene, such as CUT TO:.

Try again.context: Button that repeats a failed action.

Type.context: Label before a choice of element type (scene heading, dialogue…).

Undo ⌘Z.context: Edit menu item with its shortcut. Keep the shortcut and spaces.

Unsaved changes.context: Status bar message: the project has edits not yet saved.

Untitled.context: Name given to something that has no title yet.

Use today's date.context: Button filling in the date field with today.

Used elsewhere:.context: Label before tags already used by other items.

Versions.context: Page and tab for saved versions (checkpoints and snapshots).

Weeks.context: Statistics chart period: one bar per week.

What goes in.context: Compile heading: choose which documents are included.

Where it goes.context: Compile heading: the folder and file name of the result.

Whole book.context: Compile option (radio button): compile the entire manuscript, not just one part.

Word target.context: Inspector field: the number of words a document aims for.

Words.context: Column or unit: number of words.

Words that echo.context: Statistics heading: words repeated close together in the text.

Working title.context: Project field: the draft title before a final one.

Workspace.context: Settings heading for the layout of the program window.

Write.context: Page name for the editor, and the verb.

Writing.context: Settings heading: how the editor behaves while writing.

Writing statistics….context: Menu item opening the statistics window.

Your goals.context: Statistics heading: daily word goal etc.

Your themes.context: Appearance heading above the themes the writer made.

Zip file.context: File type name in the open/save dialog for project zip files.

characters.context: Lower-case plural in the database summary line, e.g. '4 characters · 0 places'.

custom.context: Lower-case word in the database summary line: items of a kind the writer defined, e.g. '0 custom'.

e.g. Mara Venn.context: Hint in a character name box: an example name (a made-up person).

easy.context: Reading-ease description in the statistics (lower case, after the score).

events.context: Lower-case plural in the database summary line.

first page is.context: Compile header/footer: label before the number the first page gets (for example 'first page is 1').

footer from bottom.context: Compile layout: distance from the bottom edge to the page footer, in points.

in.context: Search page: small word between the search box and where to look ('Look for X in Manuscript').

payload.context: Command desk: the data part of a JSON command. Technical; may stay English.

places.context: Lower-case plural in the database summary line.

plain.context: Reading-ease description (lower case): ordinary plain language.

props.context: Lower-case plural in the database summary line.

read.context: Inspector statistic caption beneath the reading time, e.g. '2m read'.

size.context: Compile header/footer: label before the font size in points.

support.context: A link word inside the About window sentence ('please support its development'): sponsoring the project. It is a verb in the imperative, linked to the sponsors page.

words.context: Unit: number of words (lower case caption under a number).

‹ Prev.context: Pager button: previous page of results.

−{count} removed.context: Version comparison summary: number of words removed. Keep {count}.

▸ Draft.context: Label showing the Draft folder in a path. Keep the arrow.
